actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The ghoul makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +4, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +4, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage. If the target is a creature that isn't an Undead or elf, it is subjected to the following effect. _Constitution Saving Throw:_ DC 10. _Failure:_ The target has the Paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn. ## Gibbering Mouther
